column9: Bunnahabhain's core range is unpeated (see producer row); its Moine range (e.g. An Cuan Garbh, Moine Sherry Cask Finish) is heavily peated. Matches BRIEF.md's own documented pair.

Wiki: "Since 1999, the distillery has also produced a non-peated 'highland spirit'", occasionally released as Diageo Special Releases labelled "Unpeated"; the core range is peated (medium, see producer row).
Morven is Wolfburn's one peated expression ("a delicate touch of peat"); the rest of the core range including this batch's sample Langskip is unpeated (see producer row).
